entities.name: Zacharie Le Rouzic
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zacharie Le Rouzic was a French archaeologist and prehistorian, who devoted himself mainly to the study and preservation of megalithic sites in Morbihan, Brittany; he was also a writer on the folklore of the Carnac district.
